name: nano-banana
description: Realistic, 3D and photo-like images (Google Nano Banana) and short realistic or 3D animation clips (Google Veo) for presentations, decks, handouts and course screens. Free route: Claude drives the Gemini app in the browser on the person's own Google AI Pro account from a list of places and prompts decided beforehand, downloads each picture and puts it in the project - no key, no cost per picture. Every picture costs money, so Claude first finds the places a generated picture fits, asks the person to describe each one, shows the prompt and generates only after their yes - one picture at a time, counted and priced - then checks it and places it locally instead of drawing a fake 'realistic' picture in SVG. Needs one Gemini API key: the first time a picture is asked for, a small window opens and the user pastes it there - never into the chat.
